model: RISH LM1360+ RJ12 smart energy meter
applies_to: Rishabh RISH LM1360 PLUS RJ12 smart energy meters (RJ12 CT inputs) with RS-485 Modbus, per interface definition DMAN-00IM-0923 Rev. A (01/2026).
summary: The RISH LM1360+ RJ12 smart energy meter is a 96 x 96 mm panel smart energy meter that measures voltage, current, power, power factor, frequency, harmonics and energy on 3-phase 4-wire, 3-phase 3-wire or single-phase networks. Its RS-485 port speaks Modbus RTU and every reading is a 32-bit IEEE float in two registers. This map covers the regular per-phase and system parameters (Table 1.1) and the float energy registers (Table 1.3), plus the main setup registers (system type, CT/PT ratios, demand period, communication and word-order settings).

addressing.note: The manual prints 30001/40001-style addresses next to the hex start address actually sent (30001 = 0x0000). Wire address = printed number - 30001 (input registers) or - 40001 (holding registers); every value here was cross-checked against the printed hex address.

source.title: RISH LM1360PLUS RJ12 Interface Definition
source.pages: pp. 7-8 (protocol, example frames), pp. 9-30 (Tables 1.1 and 1.3), pp. 48-53 (Table 3), p. 55 (word order)

notes: Measured values are IEEE-754 32-bit floats in two registers. The manual's example responses (e.g. data bytes 43 5B 41 21 for a current reading) put the most significant register first, so ABCD is the default order.

Register 46055 (Word Order) can switch the meter to reversed register order; the manual says to write 2141.0 to it and the meter detects which order was used. If floats look wrong, check this setting.
Every measured value is also readable as a holding register (FC03) at the 4X address printed next to it in the manual; this map lists the 3X (input register, FC04) copies only.
Rows whose printed hex address does not match the decimal 3X/4X address in the manual were left out rather than guessed.
Left out: the 32-bit integer energy tables (their integer word order is not demonstrated in the manual), user-assignable registers and data-log blocks.

Where the register table has no unit column, units are left blank; energy registers follow the energy unit (Wh/kWh/MWh) configured on the meter, and 'OF' / overflow registers count roll-overs of the matching energy register.
Left out for size: min/max values (Table 1.2), individual harmonics, old parameters, digital I/O, tariff tables and data-log blocks.

integration.summary: Read measured values with FC04 (or FC03 at the 4X copies) in pairs of registers and decode them as ABCD floats. Settings are floats too and are written with FC16.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU on RS-485 is built in; set the slave address, baud rate and parity from the meter's setup menu or the RS-485 setup register.
quirks: Each parameter is two registers; reading or writing only half of a float returns an Illegal Data Address exception.
Addresses are Modicon-style: subtract 30001 or 40001 for the wire address.
Limit each read to 40 parameters (80 registers) or less.
setup: Slave address range 1-247; broadcast (address 0) is not supported.
Allow about 300 ms for the meter to answer before retrying.
gotchas: If a password lock is set, write the valid password to the Password register before changing any 4X setting; a wrong password returns exception code 2.
